ThoughtBubble.title: ThoughtBubble
ThoughtBubble.description: A floating thought and emotion shared by a signed-in user for the global AETHERIA canvas.

uid.description: The Google Auth UID of the user who released the bubble.

authorHandle.description: Display handle derived from the user's first name (e.g., @lyra).

text.description: The shared thought content, capped at 140 characters.

emotion.description: Emotion category determining the bubble's aura and badge tint.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the thought bubble was created.

dateKey.description: UTC calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format used for enforcing the 5-thoughts-a-day quota.

warmthCount.description: Number of warmth reactions received by the thought bubble, initialized at 0.

/bubbles/{bubbleId}.description: Publicly readable stream of floating thought bubbles; authenticated creation with daily quota and strict warmthCount-only updates.
